about: A wait by a real dealer of the style kameran (both hands lying still on the felt), lifted out of the live table's film by verktyg/lyft.py into the lens world of data/uppsattning.json. The same fields as the lifted deals, without a card. Both wrists are held 0.04 m over the felt. The arms are held to an upper arm of 0.289 m and a forearm of 0.279 m (SAM 3D Body's median over 67 key frames, with what it lacks on our own figure added). The depth is MediaPipe's: SAM has not read this piece. g is counted from the live table's camera (data/scen.json): the line from the head to it, turned by the head's and the eyes' own turn from how they are in the betting phases, where both dealers mostly look into the camera. blick says where the gaze ends: kameran (within 20 degrees of the line to the camera; in the waits the dealers look 8 to 18 degrees over it, likely at a screen above it), skon, plats <n>, egna korten, bordet or annat; blick_grader is its angle from the line to the camera. a is the face per frame: the shapes our own figure has, by ARKit's names, as MediaPipe's Face Landmarker scores them, 0 to 1 (null where the face was not found); evened over a tenth of a second, the blinks left as they are. Left and right are the dealer's own. It is the expression that is carried, not the face's form. data/stil-*.json, face, says which shapes carry something on a face this small and which are flutter.
djup: MediaPipe: dess egen kropps djup avgör nära och fjärran längs synlinjen; armarnas längder håller

armar.kalla: skattat: SAM 3D Body, median över 67 nyckelrutor, med det SAM saknar på vår docka lagt till (data/sam-prov/jamforelse.json, benlangder_m.rattelse)

hip_note: assumed: 0.47 m under the shoulders' middle; the hips are hidden behind the table
huvud_note: The head's own turn, without the eyes, into the lifted pieces already in lift_dir (nothing else in them changes): per (verktyg/lyft.py huvud): huvud is nod, turn, tilt in degrees from rest, hv the point the head faces.
